notes: Companion 1.1.0 - 1.4.0 (first release with an update check is 1.1.0; 1.0.x sent nothing). Raw https.request POST, Content-Type application/json, JSON.stringify(payload). app_build is the raw (untrimmed) BUILD file written by tools/build_writefile.sh as `<git branch>-<short hash>` (e.g. 'master-895bcbe'; a detached-HEAD CI build would give '(HEAD detached at v1.1.0)-895bcbe'). Not semver, so server returns 'Invalid version format'. tz is (offset>=0?'+':'-')+parseInt(offset/60): a string like '+1'; for negative offsets it is double-minus ('--5'). cpus is os.cpus() verbatim. id is a shortid from <config>/machid. app_version is added last, after package.json is read. Posted to /updates (flat body) - needs proxy rewrite to /updates-old.
